3. 我建议改进你的 50 英里方案

不是简单检查半径 50 英里的所有危险天气，而是分成两个范围。

示意图：车辆朝北行驶，前方强降雨应该优先播报，侧后方普通降雨则可忽略。

可以采取下面的策略：

  • 一级：前方危险。使用 GPS heading 建立一个约 ±30°～45° 的扇形，重点关注前方 30～50 英里内的危险天气。

  • 二级：周边严重天气。例如 Tornado Warning、严重冰雹等，即使不在正前方，也可以进行适当提醒。

  • 三级：路线精确判断。如果获得 Navigation Connect 的 Polyline，就只分析路线附近的危险天气。

这里特别值得增加一个功能：预测车辆到达危险区域时的天气，而不仅是检查当前天气。

例如车辆前方 30 英里有强降雨，车速 60 mph，预计 30 分钟后到达。我们应该使用对应未来时刻的短时天气预报来判断风险。

示例语音提醒

“前方约 20 英里可能遇到强降雨，预计 20 分钟后进入该区域，请注意路面积水并降低车速。”

实际产品还需要控制播报频率、过滤定位误差，避免打断 Google Maps 的转弯指令，尤其不能因为 50 英里范围内出现天气，就误报为“前方有危险”。

4. 我的实现建议

我会把它规划成两个阶段：

第一阶段：Android 独立 Weather Companion App

使用手机 GPS + 天气数据，实现后台监测、语音播报和简单通知。完全不需要 Google Maps API，也不依赖它是否正在运行。

第二阶段：Navigation Connect 集成

用户在我们的 App 中选择目的地，然后启动 Google Maps。后台获取 Google Maps 实际路线，结合天气风险计算。可以进一步做到路线级别的天气预警。

Navigation Connect 目前仍处于 Preview，Google 官方也建议生产环境采用备用机制，因此独立 GPS 方案有长期保留的价值。

Google for Developers

我认为最重要的一点是：我们不需要和 Google Maps 竞争导航功能。 用户继续使用 Google Maps，我们只专注于实时和未来的道路天气风险提醒。

这样既能利用现有的天气与道路数据，也更容易从一个小型 Android App 开始验证产品。

Writing

Weather-Aware Driving Assistant

Integration with Google Maps

1. Project Overview

We propose developing a Weather Companion App that runs alongside Google Maps or Waze, providing real-time weather alerts while users continue using their preferred navigation application.

The goal is not to replace Google Maps, but to enhance driving safety by providing weather-related information that traditional navigation systems may not offer.

Key features:

  • Monitor severe weather within approximately 50 miles of the vehicle.

  • Use GPS location, speed, and travel direction to prioritize weather conditions ahead.

  • Provide voice alerts for heavy rain, snow, ice, hail, and severe storms.

  • Display small notifications without interrupting navigation.

  • Estimate weather conditions at the time the driver reaches an affected area.

2. Two Implementation Options

Option A: Independent Weather Companion App

This approach does not require integration with Google Maps.

The application runs in the background and uses the phone's GPS to determine location, speed, and travel direction.

It combines this information with weather radar, short-term forecasts, and severe weather alerts to identify potential hazards.

Advantages:

  • No Google Maps API fees.

  • Relatively straightforward Android implementation.

  • Works alongside Google Maps, Waze, or other navigation apps.

  • Can support iOS with additional background execution restrictions.

Limitation: Without access to the actual navigation route, the application cannot determine whether the driver will turn or continue straight.

Option B: Google Navigation Connect API

Google offers a Navigation Connect API that allows authorized applications to receive navigation information from supported Google Maps and Waze sessions.

Potential capabilities include:

  • Access to the remaining navigation route (polyline).

  • Real-time location, ETA, and remaining distance.

  • Route updates when navigation changes.

  • More accurate weather alerts based on the actual route.

This enables weather analysis along the driver's planned route rather than relying only on GPS heading.

Limitations: The API requires supported platforms, user authorization, and navigation initiated through the integrated application. It cannot simply extract routes from any independently running Google Maps session. Platform support and feature availability are also limited.

3. Recommended Development Strategy

Phase 1 — Independent Android App

Build a lightweight background weather assistant using GPS and existing weather datasets.

Focus on voice alerts, severe weather detection, and direction-based filtering. This avoids Google Maps API costs and allows rapid validation.

Phase 2 — Navigation Connect Integration

Integrate with Google Maps where supported to obtain actual navigation routes.

Use route geometry and estimated arrival times to deliver more accurate, location-specific weather warnings.

Phase 3 — Advanced Road Weather Intelligence

Combine weather forecasts with road conditions, traffic incidents, highway sensors, and roadside cameras.

This could provide warnings about hazardous road conditions before the driver reaches the affected location.

4. Conclusion

The project is technically feasible and can be developed without replacing Google Maps.

An independent GPS-based weather assistant provides a low-cost starting point, while Google Navigation Connect offers a more advanced route-aware solution.

The recommended approach is to begin with the independent application and evaluate Google Maps integration after validating the core weather alert functionality.

Kotlin 的优势在于可以直接使用 Android 原生的后台定位、Foreground Service、TextToSpeech 和通知 API。

2. 第一版 APK 可以非常简单

我建议只做五个功能：

  1. Start / Stop：手动启动或停止天气监测。

  2. GPS：每 10～15 秒获取位置、速度和行进方向。

  3. Weather API：每 1～2 分钟查询一次前方 50 英里的天气风险。

  4. Voice Alert：检测到危险天气时自动播报，使用 Android 内置 TTS，无需云端语音服务。

  5. Alert History：记录播报时间、位置和预警内容，方便测试。

为了避免不断重复播报，同一危险事件可以设置 10 分钟冷却时间，只有风险明显升级时才提前再次提醒。

3. APK 如何开发和安装？

Android Studio

Google 官方开发工具，免费，支持 Windows、Ubuntu 和 macOS。

基本流程：

  1. 在电脑上安装 Android Studio。

  2. 创建 Kotlin Android 项目。

  3. 编写后台定位 Service 和 TTS 语音功能。

  4. 通过 Gradle 编译 Debug APK。

  5. 使用 USB + ADB，或者直接复制 APK 到手机安装。

  6. 启动监测后切换到 Google Maps，检查后台语音是否正常。

Android 官方允许通过带持续通知的 Location Foreground Service，在 App 切换到后台后继续接收定位数据。需要正确配置定位权限和服务类型。

3. Kotlin 代码实际上非常简单

Kotlin
val tts = TextToSpeech(this) { status ->
    if (status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS) {
        tts.language = Locale.US

        tts.speak(
            "Warning. Heavy rain ahead in 15 miles.",
            TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH,
            null,
            "weather_alert"
        )
    }
}

这只是演示代码。正式应用还需要管理 TTS 初始化、生命周期和错误回调。

Android Developers

另外，对于你的导航场景，Audio Focus 非常重要。Android 支持临时获取音频焦点，让音乐音量暂时降低，再播放语音警报。但与 Google Maps 导航语音同时运行时，仍需实际测试两者的优先级。
